kitQa.reviewScope: All 60 paired top/oblique diagnostics visually inspected across four sheets against official kitting; units/physical rows, row slope, dish, F/J bars, stepped Caps, space convexity, legends and palette checked. Automated 120 image bounds + 60 texture bounds + actual material texture binding and finite UVs. Visualization-quality approval only, not exact retail mold certification.

visualQa.scope: Visually inspected all twelve actual-angle PNGs in three four-frame contact sheets and front full-frame. Consistent ice-blue housing and three-tone purple NicePBT Purple Chonkers retail caps; no personal brand keys, no keyboard cropping, stable camera and geometry. Reviewed visible key profile including stepped Caps Lock, occlusion, side USB opening, rear plate/weight, feet, perforations, shadows and silhouette. Exact physical geometry, legends/fonts and filament color are approximate visualization, not fit or color certification. Frozen individual-key QA remains separate.
